title: Cookie Policy
bodyHtml:
What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember information about your visit — like whether you're logged in — across page loads and sessions.

Cookies We Use

HomeWODRx doesn't use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, so there's no cookie banner.

  • Essential cookie — a login cookie for the site's administrator only. Visitors don't receive it.

Two related things that aren't cookies: your light or dark display choice is saved in your own browser's storage and never sent to us, and we count visits without cookies (see the Privacy Policy). Embedded YouTube videos use YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode and only load when you press play; once playing, YouTube's own policies apply.

Controlling Cookies

You can view and delete cookies at any time in your browser settings. Because the site sets no cookies for visitors, blocking cookies doesn't change how it works for you.

Updates to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy as the site evolves and new technologies are introduced. The date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision.

Questions? Contact us
